correctness.rationale: Smoothness follows from explicit partial derivatives for every prime >=5. Frobenius on H^1(O_C) is computed by the standard Cech coefficient formula. Exhaustive all-prime exponent and congruence solving yields ranks 3,2,1,0 with the listed multinomial coefficients nonzero mod p; their square/cube have the same ranks. The Cartier a-number and polarization/slope constraints then force the four stated Newton polygons. Python checker reproduced independent coefficient computations for every prime 5..109; no finite sample is asserted as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural 48-automorphism quartic is a distinguished genus-three curve, and reduction of its Jacobian is a motivated arithmetic question. The known superspecial endpoint leaves the two intermediate possible Newton types undetermined; this explicit complete residue-class classification identifies both infinitely occurring strata, their stable ranks and a-numbers. It supplies meaningful exact arithmetic information, not a random parameter slice or new generic algorithm.
